branch_rules: Reliable K-to-H rescue across at least 2 families in at least 2 models is a candidate for a new independently sourced behavioral test; this screen is not significance, generality or a mechanism.
If K/H/P share similar event errors, prioritize evidence-use diagnosis and preserve the specific counterexamples.
If only P helps, keep a wording/explicitness explanation; do not call it character interference.
If correct throughout or mixed/sparse, report insufficient discrimination and review difficulty/materials before a separately preregistered next test.
If references/equivalence/scoring fail, stop causal interpretation and repair materials in a new version; retain outputs.
